name: The Causeway Breathes
effect: Place 1 allied Stone marker on an empty tile within 2 of the center tile. The active player's first movement action this turn may move through 1 placed object without taking effects from that object, but must end on an empty tile.
flavor: The road was drowned, not dead.
role: The drowned ley-road wakes because something buried has begun calling through it.
mechanical_lane: Stone marker placement and temporary route movement.

narrative.summary: A submerged basalt causeway shifts for the first time in centuries. The survivors know this is not a miracle. It is a warning.
narrative.forbidden_truth: The roads were not built only for evacuation; some were built to hide what Atlantis did before the Flood.

art_prompt: A black basalt causeway rising under shallow dark water inside a sealed Atlantean-Egyptian tunnel, one wet stone block glowing as if remembering a buried road.
review_notes: Draft event card, not yet added to the playable prototype shared relic/event deck.
Uses regular Stone markers rather than adding a separate Stone Route marker type.
Movement bypass is intentionally simple: pass through one placed object and ignore that object's effect.
Pairs with Stone-Line Laborer, Ahesu, and Iset-Nara.

name: Black Water Remembers
effect: Choose 1 allied character adjacent to a placed object. That character gains 1 Memory marker, max 1 per character. Then move that character 1 tile. It must end on an empty tile.
flavor: The water gives back what the queens edited out.
role: Floodwater reflects the truth of what happened during the fall of Atlantis.
mechanical_lane: Memory as protection and small repositioning.

narrative.summary: A flooded tomb shaft turns black and reflective. Those who look into it do not see themselves. They see the moment the water came.
narrative.forbidden_truth: Some survivors were saved because other survivors were deliberately sealed out.

art_prompt: A flooded tomb shaft reflecting screaming Atlantean streets instead of the character looking into it, with small memory lights rising from the black water.
review_notes: Draft event card, not yet added to the playable prototype shared relic/event deck.
Leans into forbidden truth without making the card cancel itself out.
Simple Memory gain plus movement keeps the card useful and readable.

name: The Vault Chooses A Witness
effect: Choose 1 allied character adjacent to a placed object. It gains +1 RANGE on its next AP ability this turn, then becomes Marked until the end of the round.
flavor: It opened for the one person everyone hoped would stay ignorant.
role: A sealed archive opens for one character and brands them with knowledge others were denied.
mechanical_lane: Single-character knowledge bonus with exposure cost.

narrative.summary: The vault door ignores priests, soldiers, and queens. It opens for one witness only.
narrative.forbidden_truth: The archive does not preserve the official version. It preserves the version someone died to hide.

art_prompt: A single figure lit by a narrow green-white line from a sealed stone vault, with carved Atlantean and Egyptian measurements waking around the doorway.
review_notes: Draft event card, not yet added to the playable prototype shared relic/event deck.
Represents a temporary vault opening without adding extra Vault markers.
Kept intentionally simple after review: range bonus with exposure cost.
Good visual tie to Iset-Nara and Sahu-Ren.

name: The Flood Reaches The Walls
effect: Each character on an outer edge tile becomes Marked until the end of the round.
flavor: The sea always finds the edge first.
role: The old Flood returns at the limits of the board, making characters at the walls exposed and vulnerable.

narrative.summary: Water seeps through every outside wall at once. The refuges remember that safety was always temporary.
narrative.forbidden_truth: The Flood did not end; it only learned where the survivors were hiding.

art_prompt: Black floodwater breaking through the outer walls of a square stone chamber, driving figures inward toward a glowing center tile while edge stones vanish under the tide.
review_notes: Draft event card, not yet added to the playable prototype shared relic/event deck.
Replaces The Name Was Cut From Stone to give the Flood Survivor event set a direct flood-pressure card.
Makes edge positioning dangerous with minimal board-state upkeep.

name: Ley Stones Align
effect: Until end of turn, the active player's first AP ability may measure range from an allied Stone marker or allied placed object instead of from the acting character.
flavor: The stones were not pointing at stars. The stars were pointing at the crime.
role: Ancient stones form a pattern that was not built for travel, but for hiding a crime.

narrative.summary: Basalt markers beneath the board align with stars no living sky still shows.
narrative.forbidden_truth: The geometry was designed to preserve a secret, not a civilization.

art_prompt: A ring of wet basalt stones aligning with impossible star points above a submerged chamber, with an Atlantean measuring cord drawn through the water.
review_notes: Draft event card, not yet added to the playable prototype shared relic/event deck.
Avoids deck viewing/manipulation and strengthens Flood Survivor object identity.
Strong with Iset-Nara, Meret-Anu, Sahu-Ren, and Thalassa-Nekh.

name: The Drowned Seraph Speaks
effect: Choose your Mystic. Until the start of your next turn, the first enemy that damages your Mystic becomes Marked after the attack resolves. If your Mystic is Thalassa-Nekh, she also gains Shield.
flavor: Everyone heard the judgment in their own oldest language.
role: The entity inside Thalassa-Nekh speaks a judgment no ruler can redact.

narrative.summary: The water speaks through a human mouth, and every listener remembers being guilty.
narrative.forbidden_truth: The thing named holy by the survivors may not belong to them, and may not forgive them.

art_prompt: A human oracle silhouette in black water with vast translucent angelic geometry forming behind her, while kneeling listeners see their own guilt in the surface.
review_notes: Draft event card, not yet added to the playable prototype shared relic/event deck.
Should feel spiritual and unsettling rather than generic angelic intervention.
Mystic-centered event by review direction.
Thalassa-Nekh gets a small bonus without making the event unusable for other Mystics.

name: Tide-Sealed Archive Opens
effect: Choose one allied character. Give it Shield, or give it Shield and +1 RANGE on its next AP ability this turn, then Mark it until the end of the round.
flavor: The casket opened enough to help, not enough to confess.
role: Meret-Anu's preserved records reveal a controlled truth, but the full archive wants release.
mechanical_lane: Choice between safe benefit and stronger exposed benefit.

narrative.summary: The sealed casket opens enough to help, but not enough to be honest.
narrative.forbidden_truth: Meret-Anu has protected her people by controlling which truths are allowed to survive.

art_prompt: A tide-sealed royal casket cracking open in Queen Meret-Anu's hands, releasing thin lines of water-light that form witness faces and erased records.
review_notes: Draft event card, not yet added to the playable prototype shared relic/event deck.
Tide-Sealed Archive can also remain a relic; this event represents a temporary opening of that relic's records.
Readable choice card: safe Shield or stronger power with Marked.

name: Exiles Walk Beneath Egypt
effect: Move up to 2 allied characters that are adjacent to placed objects up to 1 tile each. They must end on empty tiles.
flavor: They did not rebuild Atlantis. They buried instructions for surviving it.
role: The survivors carry forbidden Atlantean memory into underground routes, tomb geometry, and future mystery traditions.
mechanical_lane: Small group reposition around placed objects.

narrative.summary: The flood survivors do not return to the surface as conquerors. They travel beneath it, leaving measurements, rites, and secrets inside stone.
narrative.forbidden_truth: Egypt and later mystery traditions may have inherited not a pure wisdom, but a carefully edited survivor record.

art_prompt: A quiet line of Atlantean survivors moving through a torchlit tunnel beneath early Egyptian stonework, carrying tablets, burial cloths, and memory pearls.
review_notes: Draft event card, not yet added to the playable prototype shared relic/event deck.
Bridge card from Flood Survivors into Egyptian/Hermetic story material.
Keeps movement small but tactically useful around Stone markers and vault objects.
